description: Independently worded fictional structural-rule positive and hard-negative regression passages; not copied from the private news holdout set.

cases.text: Almost everyone in the club has enrolled, therefore you should register too.
Either the council approves the arena or the whole district will collapse financially.
He is a fool, so his argument is worthless.
You suggest a review of fees, so you clearly want to abolish all payments.
If we make one exception to the permits, all the controls will disappear.
No one has proved this treatment is dangerous, so it must be safe.
Revenue grew after the conference, so the conference caused the change.
These figures prove our plan is a success; ignore the other results.
You criticise the train operator for delays, but you were late yourself, so your complaint is invalid.
You must approve this because doing otherwise would break her heart.
When will the manager finally admit that he concealed the information?
Unless you personally witnessed the incident, you cannot reach a conclusion about it.
The whole district agrees with the proposal, despite no survey being carried out.
The committee will hate your suggestion, so you should be silent.
Before you listen to the advisor, remember she cannot be trusted.
Why criticise the waste at the zoo when another organisation has a bigger deficit?
Our director should be forgiven for the same mistake, but the trainee should be punished.
I said the device needed one successful run, but now I demand another ten tests.
A famous singer backs the construction, so it must be scientifically sound.
If you truly cared about the community, you would approve without debate.
Every problem in the office is caused by one group of interns.
Millions of residents use this service, therefore it must be the best service.
The majority of pupils prefer the candidate, therefore you should support her.
The allegation has not been disproved, so it must be true.
We found three studies that confirm the idea; ignore the other evidence.
Almost every member of the club has paid their annual fee.
The whole neighbourhood attended the festival, according to the organisers.
The council will vote on an arena proposal next month.
The mayor gave two options but stated that several alternatives remained open.
The advisor disagreed with the consultant's calculations.
The school decided to review the fees following a public consultation.
If the permit is changed, the building inspector will conduct another inspection.
No one has submitted evidence about the safety of the device yet.
Revenue increased after the new venue opened, according to financial records.
The survey reported both favourable and unfavourable results in the appendix.
The operator was late, and the passenger made a complaint.
Participants said the decision affected their families emotionally.
The manager explained when the meeting would take place.
Inspectors personally visited the site before issuing their written report.
The whole district was surveyed and most participants supported the proposal.
The committee is scheduled to vote on the suggestion tomorrow.
The advisor was invited to present the findings at a public hearing.
The zoo reported higher spending than in the previous financial year.
The manager and the trainee were both given written warnings for the same mistake.
An updated testing target was agreed by both sides before the first test.
The singer attended the opening ceremony and thanked the engineers.
Community residents were invited to submit comments before the proposal was approved.
The group of interns met with the senior staff to discuss office procedures.
Most voters said they preferred candidate B in the representative survey.
The data show that nobody found a safety problem in the completed trials.
The new study cites three research papers and also describes their limitations.
Two alternative plans are being assessed, but others may still be proposed.
The consultant said the director was foolish to ignore the evidence.
The chairman predicted that the committee might reject the proposal, based on its published voting rules.
The report does not establish whether the disruption was connected to the permit change.
Last year's lack of test results does not demonstrate that the device is safe.
The report considered road repairs and listed costs alongside the main budget.
